learnMoreCopy.visibility: Visibility controls who can discover details about you. "Contacts" means mutual follows. Changes save to your account and apply on every device.

learnMoreCopy.autoDownload: On mobile data, "Wi‑Fi only" helps avoid unexpected charges. "Never" means you tap to download each file.
learnMoreCopy.autoCleanup: Old cached images and files are removed automatically. Messages in your account are not deleted.
